# Adapt Agency
> AI-powered websites, apps, and tailored AI services — including multilingual sites and apps and international delivery — with clear scope and human judgment.

## About
Adapt Agency is an Australia-based digital agency that helps businesses ship AI-powered websites, apps, and AI services. We use AI across discovery, implementation, and quality — always with human judgment on architecture, security, and what ships to production. We focus on real-world usefulness and clear scope over corporate theatre.

## What we build
- **Websites & content** — Fast, accessible marketing and content sites, including multilingual and localised experiences, with AI speed in production and human polish in brand and UX.
- **Apps & integrations** — Internal tools and customer apps wired to your data, including multilingual interfaces and locale-aware flows, with maintainable code and clear ownership.
- **AI services** — Workflow automation, assistants, and content pipelines, including multilingual content and review workflows, implemented with guardrails you can defend.

## How we deliver
- **Scoping & phases** — Written assumptions, milestones, and change control, so "done" stays definable.
- **AI in the loop** — Models and agents for faster drafting, refactors, and iteration; human review on architecture, security, and anything customer-facing.
- **Performance & accessibility** — Baseline checks for speed, semantics, and keyboard use, so launches are not a surprise for real users.
- **Stacks that last** — Plain HTML where it fits; APIs and integrations where they earn their keep; documented for the next person who touches the code.
- **International context & multilingual** — Copy, UX, and technical i18n as part of the product, not an afterthought; we collaborate across time zones.
- **Handover you can use** — Repos, deploy notes, and walkthroughs, so you are not locked in when the project ends.

## Who we work with
Local businesses, trades, professional services, schools and community groups, and regional teams — shops and operators who need websites and software that work in the real world.
